runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 15:14 sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade LIVE item was added. Upwork surfaced a close WooCommerce/admin VA: Worldwide remote, 10–15 h/week, $6–12/h, ongoing, but it requires clear English plus WooCommerce, QuickBooks Online and Etsy experience and the client account is brand-new with no visible spend/history; kept out of LIVE. Other Upwork results were low-budget, hard-development, strong-English or country-restricted. Public Reddit results were supply-side/stale. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Client trust floor for brand-new freelance accounts
developmentChanges.reason: For Upwork/freelance promotion, separate role fit from client trust. Brand-new clients with no visible spend, hires or payment history should require stronger compensation, clearer scope and lower competition before LIVE promotion; otherwise keep as verification-only even when the task fit is strong.

developmentChanges.title: Adjacent-tool learning debt score
developmentChanges.reason: Quantify extra mandatory tools around an otherwise strong core fit (for example WooCommerce plus QuickBooks Online plus Etsy). Penalize cumulative onboarding debt so a role is not overrated merely because one preferred keyword matches.
